get.description: Validated, cached. Response carries an `X-Cache: HIT|MISS` header.

400.description: Validation error (unsupported query/filter field, pageSize over max, unbounded pageSize without a scoping person_id, etc.)

parameters.name: countOnly
parameters.description: Return only the count, no rows

post.description: Validated, cached search. Same handler and same X-Cache/response shape as GET /omop/person — pagination/sort/attrs/count are query params here too; this route just adds a filter body.

schema.description: Flat, DB-column-keyed filter — every key must be a real column on the person table (e.g. gender_concept_id, person_id). No wrapper object.

400.description: Validation error (unsupported filter field, bad type, pageSize over max, unbounded pageSize without a scoping person_id, etc.)

parameters.description: Return only the count, no rows
